result.title: AdaTutor: Adaptive Tutoring through Pedagogical Strategy Selection
result.summary: Effective tutoring requires determining not only what information to provide, but also which form of assistance to deliver. A tutor may address the same student error using various pedagogical strategies, adapting its approach as the interaction progresses. We introduce Comparative Pedagogical Supervision (CPS), a training framework to learn to select the optimal strategy and feedback for student learning. We evaluate CPS on math and science reasoning datasets. After five tutoring turns, CPS outperforms the strongest fixed-strategy baselines. The learned tutor transfers across datasets, and its strategy selection can also inform a separate API-based tutor.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AdaTutor，用「比较式教学监督」（CPS）训练模型在多轮辅导中选择合适的教学策略与反馈形式，并在数学、科学推理数据上验证其优于固定策略基线且可跨数据集迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不仅决定给什么信息、还决定以何种形式介入」的多轮策略选择与比较式监督，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 一类动作选择策略的训练与评价提供线索，具体策略标注与比较监督方式待核查。
